title: Dataplex adds LLM token tracking for Data Documentation
summary: Dataplex now provides granular observability for LLM-powered data documentation scans, including detailed token usage and compute unit consumption.
details: The `GoogleCloudDataplexV1DataScanEvent` has been expanded to include a `dataDocumentation` result object. This object contains a comprehensive `billableTokenUsage` breakdown, covering `inputTokenCount`, `outputTokenCount`, `cachedContentTokenCount`, and even `thoughtsTokenCount` for reasoning-heavy (Chain-of-Thought) scans. Additionally, `GoogleCloudDataplexV1DataScanEventDataProfileResult` now reports `dcuConsumed`, allowing for precise monitoring of Dataplex Compute Units (DCUs) used during data profiling. These changes enable developers to better monitor the costs and performance of AI-driven metadata insights.
